The 5th anniversary foil hero collection:

The 5th Anniversary Foil Hero Collection is a box full of beautiful hero characters, all in foil and with new art! It will have not just the hero variants, but all of the hero character cards, including those from the core game and each expansion! However, we want to make this a special thing for just this year, so we're only going to make enough to cover this Kickstarter plus a few hundred extras to sell at Gen Con and to retailers. ChronoRanger_101, there's a space specifically for the large villain cards. See the detailed diagram in Updates #2 and #3. I also hope for a better idea how the mission cards work, and share your assumption about old heroes/new villains, etc.

 

In terms of kickstarter, you'll only get the stuff a short time before it's available on the market. About the stretch goals, that depends on the product and the stretch goal. In this case, you will get the following products that will be available eventually for retail (with the current stretch goals):

  • OblivAeon expansion
  • Hero variant collection (foiled or not) and carrying case, depending on your pledge level
  • Benchmark mini-expansion
  • Stuntman mini-expansion
  • Void Guard small expansion (4 hero decks)

In addition, the following products will not be available for retail:

  • 18 promo hero variant cards so far
  • Art prints, if you add $1 to your pledge
  • Large signed canvas print, at the $249 level

I think it's safe to say you will be getting a substantial discount over what you would pay later, except maybe at the $399 level.
